top: Alabama Voice Of Teachers For Education

cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 10 (Huntsville) since winning a March 2024 special election. Licensed professional counselor in private practice. Earlier worked in community mental health, banking and aerospace. Author of a book on keeping the Sabbath.

endorsements.text: Planned Parenthood endorsed her in the 2024 special election.

cands.gaps: Her birthplace and the year she moved to Huntsville are not stated in the sources we could read. We found no records of bills she sponsored, and no stated positions or actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, policing, gun laws or school choice and teacher pay. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022, 2024 or 2026. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or land-use statements about her.

cands.bio: Aaron Thomas is a Republican small business owner who also works at Redstone Arsenal, according to his campaign site. He is a husband and father of two. He ran for Alabama House District 10 in 2026 and has held no prior elected office that we could confirm.

endorsements.text: In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Thomas listed the Alabama Farmers Federation and the Alabama Forestry Association as endorsers. This is self-reported, and Ballotpedia says it did not independently identify any endorsements.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Aaron Thomas was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. We found no record of prior public office or of any career in law, policy or budgeting. We found no stated position on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or foreign land buyers, abortion, gun laws or immigration and H-1B. We found no clear position on slowing growth, though his site says he welcomes new investment and supports responsible economic development. His campaign site says local governments should have clear policies for Flock cameras, but the page was cut off and we could not read the rest of that section. No stated position on refusing donor money was found.
